_about: Film topic backlog (README 10절). Every periodic analysis attaches evidence here (topic.mjs cite) and recommends 2–3 (topic.mjs recommend) instead of writing new candidates only into ANALYTICS.md; the maintainer picks one (film.mjs approve <film> topic), then topic.mjs pick <id> <film>. status: candidate | recommended | picked | made. `connection` = the link of God's plan the film follows (README 10절 — pick topics where it is clear).
